description: Committee recommends updating and enhancing Saskatoon's Heritage Conservation Program.

chips.text: Debate on low uptake of $4,000 facade grant, not effective for large projects.
Owners of designated heritage properties are affected by program changes.
Unclear how much of the requested funding is new mill rate impact.

description: Identifies annual funding gaps for parks ($3.3M) and green network ($789K).
Requires $675,000 one-time for urban forest pruning.
Green Network included in asset management for first time.

chips.text: Green Network provides stormwater management, carbon storage, and biodiversity.
Capital funding requests for Green Network will be submitted to budget.

description: Elmwood seeks to buy Nutana park land for a community hub.
Project includes 136 units, 42 affordable, with $1.1M incentive.
The land sale request will proceed to a public hearing.

chips.text: Mayor Block gained a fresh perspective on enhancing public space after visiting the site.
Project provides accessible, affordable housing for individuals with intellectual disabilities.

description: City to find storage and new site for Rotary Community Garden.
Administration to report on future plans for remediated land.

chips.text: Miki Mappin stated the community feels "railroaded" by the city's process.
Low-income, inner-city residents rely on the garden for food and space.
A petition with 175 signatures opposed the garden's eviction.
